carried_set_rule: As decision 33: one tracker is judged at G7 under §C.13's rules, unchanged. This is the one allowed re-score: a fail or an inconclusive result is final.
change: Decision 34 (owner 2026-11-06): the one re-score that SRD Annex C §C.13 / C.5 allows of G7 on seed 215 (inconclusive, panel rounds 1-2): the same tracker, reference, frozen T2 and frozen multipliers as decision 33, the same rules (owner chose to keep them), on fresh seed 216 with a larger test split: 1,100,000 scenarios, its 110,000-scenario test split generated alone, sized by the panel so that a ±0.3 pp coverage interval is reachable. After it, a fail or inconclusive is final.
rationale: G7 on seed 215 was inconclusive on one check: fused log-range 50% coverage 48.32% [47.81, 48.82] against a 48% floor; the other eight passed (experiments/20261106-p6u-g7/). The panel judged the shortfall systematic (about 3 SE; plausibly the reuse of seed-211 validation for T2's epoch, k and M, and the multipliers) and the coverage marginal only (log-range 50% 67.2% before any manoeuvre, 38.2% after one). tma-g7 was changed only to stream rows (memory), and re-scores seed 215 with identical checks. Forecast before scoring: the log-range 50% coverage centres near 48.3% again, with a half-width of about 0.3 pp, so P(pass) is about 50%; a fail needs a point below about 47.7% and is unlikely. A pass would show only that the pooled coverage reaches the floor, not that the tracker is well calibrated; conditional coverage is expected to stay poor and is reported (regimes).
